name: Full cart flow: browse → product → qty → add more → confirm → pickup time
description: End-to-end multi-item order flow. Browses Meat, selects a product, enters qty, adds another product from Dairy, enters qty, confirms cart, provides pickup time, and verifies order confirmation template is sent.

steps.note: Browse button — must send category list-picker with 6 variables
Select 5th category (Meat) — must send a product list-picker template
Select first Meat product — must send qty template
Enter qty 2 — must show cart summary with add-more/confirm options
Choose add more (1) — must send category list-picker again
Select 3rd category (Dairy) — must send a product list-picker template
Select first Dairy product — must send qty template
Enter qty 3 — cart now has 2 items, must show add-more/confirm
Choose confirm cart (2) — must ask for pickup time
Provide pickup time — must send order confirmation template or confirmation text
